newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Alfa-Bank plans $100 mln 3-yr Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Alfa-Bank plans $100 mln 3-yr Eurobond.

text.p: Russia's Alfa-Bank plans to start from July 14 a Eurobond issue of up to $100 million with a three-year maturity, the bank said in a statement on Tuesday.

"The start of the open issue is preliminarily planned for July 14," the statement said. "The programme envisages issuing Eurobonds for the overall sum of up to $100 million with a maturity of three years, and will be led by...Goldman Sachs."
A road show has been organised, with representatives of Alfa and Goldman visiting five financial centres in Europe and Asia between July 7 and July 13.
"The funds we raise will be used for providing future credit for Alfa-Bank's biggest clients, and for investments in a number of medium-term projects in Russia's region," the statememt said.

Alfa said it had received long-term credit ratings from three major rating agencies -- Moody's Investors Service had assigned the bank a B1 rating, Standard & Poor's a single-'B' and IBCA, Europe's international credit rating agency, BB minus.
